arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Treasury data from the bulletins (in millions of dollars)
# June 1991
europe_1991 = 268166
latam_1991 = 337565

# June 1996
europe_1996 = 426245
latam_1996 = 443872

# Linear regression: latam = beta0 + beta1 * europe
# With two points, this is a simple linear interpolation
# slope (beta1) = (latam_1996 - latam_1991) / (europe_1996 - europe_1991)
slope = (latam_1996 - latam_1991) / (europe_1996 - europe_1991)
# intercept (beta0) = latam_1991 - slope * europe_1991
intercept = latam_1991 - slope * europe_1991

print(f"Linear Regression:")
print(f"  slope (beta1) = {slope}")
print(f"  intercept (beta0) = {intercept}")

# Germany GDP in billions (from World Bank)
germany_gdp_1991 = 1875.79
germany_gdp_1996 = 2506.58

# Germany's percentage growth rate
germany_growth_rate = (germany_gdp_1996 - germany_gdp_1991) / germany_gdp_1991 * 100
print(f"\nGermany GDP growth rate: {germany_growth_rate:.4f}%")

# Apply growth rate to June 1991 Europe value (counterfactual)
# counterfactual_europe_1996 = europe_1991 * (1 + germany_growth_rate/100)
counterfactual_europe_1996 = europe_1991 * (1 + germany_growth_rate/100)
print(f"\nCounterfactual Europe 1996: {counterfactual_europe_1996:.2f} million")

# Use regression to predict Latin America from counterfactual Europe
predicted_latam = intercept + slope * counterfactual_europe_1996
print(f"Predicted Latin America (from counterfactual): {predicted_latam:.2f} million")

# Actual June 1996 Latin America
print(f"Actual Latin America 1996: {latam_1996} million")

# Absolute difference from actual
abs_diff = abs(predicted_latam - latam_1996)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff:.2f} million")

# Express as percentage of actual June 1996 value
pct_of_actual = (abs_diff / latam_1996) * 100
print(f"Percentage of actual: {pct_of_actual:.4f}%")

# U.S. total liabilities growth (Europe + Latin America as proxy)
total_1991 = europe_1991 + latam_1991
total_1996 = europe_1996 + latam_1996
us_growth_ratio = (total_1996 - total_1991) / total_1991
print(f"\nUS total liabilities growth ratio: {us_growth_ratio:.6f}")

# Multiply: percentage * US growth ratio
final_result = pct_of_actual * us_growth_ratio
print(f"\nFinal result: {final_result:.2f}")

# Write to answer.txt
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded to 2 decimal places): {final_result:.2f}")
EOF
